subject: Money
title: Carbon Tax
description: A micro-lesson that makes Carbon Tax usable.

hook.text: Sweden introduced a carbon tax in 1991 at $26 per ton. By 2023, it rose to $130. Emissions fell 27%.

buildup.text: A carbon tax charges companies for each ton of CO₂ they emit. Pollution gets a price tag.

discovery.text: The logic is simple: make dirty energy expensive and clean energy wins automatically.

twist.text: Carbon taxes hit the poor hardest. Heating and driving cost more when fossil fuels are taxed.

climax.text: Canada rebates the revenue directly. Citizens receive checks to offset the cost. Tax and dividend.

punchline.text: Price the damage. Let the market fix it.

quiz.question: What happened in Sweden after introducing a carbon tax?
